name: Pens — Beers screen
description: Single screen of a dark-themed team app (window title "Pens"): a team header, a scrolling season-consumption summary with a 52-cell case tracker, a legend, a 2x2 statistic card grid, and a five-item bottom tab bar with the "Beers" tab selected. Generated from one static screenshot only; no source code, runtime inspection, or interaction data was available.

metadata.behaviorNote: No triggers or navigates-to edges are emitted. A static image cannot establish what any affordance does; such questions are recorded in unresolved.
metadata.measurementNote: Colors are sampled from the raster. Geometry is in screenshot pixels with the origin at the top-left of the window image (the OS title bar occupies y 0-34). The rendering scale factor is unknown, so pixel values may not equal device-independent pixels.
